+using System.ComponentModel;

+
+[McpServerPromptType]
+public sealed class SummarizationPrompt
+{
+    [McpServerPrompt("summarize"), Description("Summarizes text content at a chosen detail level.")]
+    public static IList<McpServerPromptMessage> Summarize(
+        [Description("The text content to summarize.")] string content,
+        [Description("Detail level: brief, standard, or detailed.")] string style = "standard")
+    {
+        var systemText = style.ToLowerInvariant() switch
+        {
+            "brief"    => "You are a summarization assistant. Provide a one-sentence summary.",
+            "detailed" => "You are a summarization assistant. Provide a thorough, multi-paragraph summary preserving key details.",
+            _          => "You are a summarization assistant. Provide a concise summary in a few sentences.",
+        };
+
+        return
+        [
+            new McpServerPromptMessage
+            {
+                Role = Role.Assistant,
+                Content = new() { Text = systemText, Type = "text" },
+            },
+            new McpServerPromptMessage
+            {
+                Role = Role.User,
+                Content = new() { Text = $"Summarize the following:\n\n{content}", Type = "text" },
+            },
+        ];
+    }
+}

The project builds successfully. Here's what was created in `McpServer/`:

**4 files, 3 key concerns addressed:**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Program.cs` | Host setup — stdio transport, DI-registered `HttpClient`, stderr-only logging |
| `Tools/ExternalApiTool.cs` | `fetch_resource` tool — takes `resourceId`, uses `IHttpClientFactory` (DI), returns JSON |
| `Prompts/SummarizationPrompt.cs` | `summarize` prompt — accepts `content` + optional `style` (brief/standard/detailed) |
| `StderrLoggerProvider.cs` | Custom logger that writes exclusively to **stderr**, keeping stdout clean for JSON-RPC |

**Logging safety**: All providers are cleared, replaced with `StderrLoggerProvider` — nothing ever writes to stdout except the MCP stdio transport.

**To configure**, update the `BaseAddress` in `Program.cs` to your actual API endpoint. To run: `dotnet run` (the server reads/writes JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout).
